title: GitHub provider slice: fourteen-category investigation with official evidence and offline fixtures
objective: Investigate GitHub across all fourteen canonical service categories using OFFICIAL docs.github.com sources only, and land a provider-scoped slice: one declarative profiles module, one provider YAML with a complete 14-entry coverage declaration, captured official fixtures covering the full seven-case vocabulary, unit + integration tests, and the GitHub section of docs/PROVIDER_ADAPTERS.md.
acceptance_criteria: A1: python -m app.ingest.runner config/examples/providers/github.example.yaml --fixtures tests/fixtures/ingest/github/html --publish runs OFFLINE against a real Postgres and persists scan_run / snapshot / candidate / official evidence, plus offer / offer_version / quota wherever the deterministic gate allows.

A2: every published offer's Z0 verdict is explainable, and at least one deliberate non-Z0 case proves a TIME-LIMITED TRIAL blocks Z0 even with no card required (GitHub Enterprise Cloud trial -> Z2), plus an UNKNOWN-material-condition case.
A3: all fourteen coverage entries present; every verified_free / offered_no_z0 traceable to an official docs.github.com source; every not_offered carries a rationale.
A4: Q9-A floor met (>=3 evidence-backed); no publicly-known GitHub free tier left unknown; no category declared unknown/not_offered while an offer is published in it.
A5: Q10-A met - every service->category assignment carries a one-line rationale in the YAML; every arguable assignment disclosed in the PR body.

A6: all seven fixture cases exercised (unchanged | changed | partial | malformed | contradictory | withdrawn | stale); the four step-3 cases assert on PERSISTED rows (change_event.change_type, materiality, gate withhold, pending review_item).
A7: alembic head still 0011; no new dependency; no network in tests; pwsh -File scripts/check.ps1 -NodeAudit exits 0.
A8: contamination control - stopping only this slice's API container moves the smoke count on exactly the API-dependent checks while an unrelated stack stays healthy.
A9: one self-invented mutation run, with the predicted result stated before running it, reported pass or fail.
verification_plan: pytest tests/unit/test_capture_sidecar.py tests/unit/test_fixture_harness.py tests/unit/test_config_system.py (shared-file byte pins + sidecar completeness must still pass)
git diff --numstat origin/main...HEAD re-derived from the PUSHED ref for every do-not-touch path

isolation.note: Local .env is NOT committed. No global Docker sweep: unrelated freetier-atlas and garmin-ai stacks are live on this host.

risks: A time-limited or 12-month introductory offer misread as always-free would ship a false $0 claim (brief section A0). Mitigation: every verified_free capture must carry perpetuity or reset language verbatim; ambiguity stays unknown.
Training data about GitHub allowances is stale - GitHub Models was RETIRED on 2026-07-30. Only the captured official page is authority.

scripts/url-allowlist.txt (do-not-touch) permits only github.com / api.github.com / docs.github.com, so github.blog (the changelog the brief suggested) cannot be cited. Correction reported to the owner.
